title: Design and Development of A Teacher-Friendly Robot to Support Children's Soft Skills Development
keywords: 3D Printing, Lightweight Robot, Soft Skills, Education, Classroom, Integration
description: Lightweight Robot, Soft Skills, Education, Classroom, Integration, 3D Printing

sections.value: We design and develop a teacher-friendly educational robot that enables teachers to easily create classroom activities through AI-supported tools. This project investigates how lightweight, 3D-printed robots can be integrated into real classrooms to support children’s soft skills development.

title: The Robot Who Carries Stories: Asynchronous Storytelling across Distant Places
description: A digital-physical hybrid tool for children's creative writing.

sections.value: We explore robots as mediators in asynchronous storytelling across distant places. By designing robot-mediated storytelling activities, this work examines how robots can create unique relational spaces for narrative construction, social sharing, and cross-cultural creative expression.

title: Probing Family AI Robot Use: Designing Workbook Probes for Families
keywords: Family, Child-Robot Interaction, AI Robot, Workbook, Research through Design
description: Family, Child-Robot Interaction, AI Robot, Workbook, Research through Design

sections.value: We study family–robot interaction through the design of a workbook-based probe that invites families' reflections on future uses of AI robots in the home. This project uses workbooks as a design research method to elicit conversations about values, expectations, and tensions around living with AI technologies.
